parts: Create a CUTOUT ANIMATION RIG KIT of the exact referenced fantasy game character. NOT an animation sheet, NO full figures. Twelve complete separate parts, EXACT FOUR COLUMNS THREE ROWS, one item per cell on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Fine ink outlines and painted cel shading matching reference, upper-left light, strict side / slight three-quarter game view facing RIGHT. Compact parts with generous transparent gaps; all pieces entirely inside their cells, no clipping. Rounded overlap at joints, no exposed diagram circles, no shadows, no labels or text. Limb segments must point STRAIGHT DOWN with the proximal joint at TOP, distal joint at BOTTOM, no diagonal posing. Head fully naturally outlined with transparent margin, not cropped, no torso. Torso armless, no head or hips; pelvis no torso or legs. Upper arm no forearm, forearm no hand. Thigh no shin, shin no foot. Boots toe RIGHT, ankle LEFT rear. Weapons must not be attached to any body part except their gripping hand. Read row-major left-to-right: ROW1: 1 HEAD of THOLGRIN, stocky male dwarf, auburn hair, thick long auburn beard, stern face, no helmet, head and beard only; 2 broad silver full-plate TORSO with gold sacred trim and red tabard from neck to waist only, NO arms/shoulder pads; 3 armored PELVIS belt/red short tabard plate tassets only; 4 ROUND SACRED SHIELD ONLY, silver/gold with an engraved open book symbol, face viewed three-quarter, isolated. ROW2: 1 armored UPPER ARM silver gold pauldron to elbow vertical; 2 plate FOREARM elbow to wrist vertical, NO hand or weapon; 3 RIGHT GAUNTLETED HAND gripping one MACE, shaft horizontal RIGHT with sacred metal mace head at RIGHT end, NO fire or magic effect; 4 RED CAPE alone flowing horizontally LEFT from clasp at RIGHT. ROW3: 1 short thick silver plate THIGH segment vertical; 2 short thick plate SHIN segment knee to ankle vertical NO foot; 3 armored BOOT FOOT with flat sole, toe RIGHT no shin; 4 LEFT GAUNTLETED HAND ONLY, no arm or shield. Preserve the dwarf identity, FULL PLATE covers every limb, red cloth and gold trim. Compact stocky proportions, large beard and strong broad chest. Exactly twelve isolated parts, NO whole character.
